page.layout: Top: two circular coin medallions side by side, each with a legend around its rim (left: POPPEA SABINA NERO. IMP. VXOR; right: STATILIA MESSALINA NERO. IMP. VXOR). Below them one column of running text in full width, two paragraphs. No marginal notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top right, signature at bottom right.

main_text.l: POPPEA SABINA NERO. IMP. VXOR
STATILIA MESSALINA[?] NERO. IMP. VXOR
POPPÆA Sabina, Tito Olio Quæstorio patre nata, Ne-
ronis vxor fuit, quam duodecimo die post diuortium Octauiæ
in matrimonium accepit. hanc dilexit vnicè: & tamen ipsam
quoque ictu calcis occidit, quòd se ex aurigatione serò reuer-
sum grauida & ægra conuiciis incesserat. hæc antea nupserat
Rufo Crispino Equiti Romano. huic Poppeæ omnia alia fuere
præter honestum animum: sermo comis, nec absurdum inge-
nium: modestiam præferebat, & lasciuia tamen vtebatur: famæ
nunquam pepercit, maritos & adulteros non distinguens. Vi-
de Sueto.in Nerone. hæc luxu supramodum diffluebat, autore
Plin.lib.34.cap II.in hæc verba: Nostra ætate Poppæa coniux

l.i: Neronis principis, delicatioribus iumentis suas soleas ex auro quoque indue-

main_text.l: STATILIA Messalina (altera quidem à Valeria illa Mes-
salina Claudij vxore, de qua à nobis dictum est supra) vxor
quoque fuit Neronis: hac vt potiretur, virum eius Atticū Ve-
stinum Consulem in honore ipso trucidauit. Hæc erat Statilij
Tauri bis Consulis, ac triumphalis, abneptis. Taurus hic tem-
poribus Augusti amphitheatrum Romæ extruxerat. fuit alter
eiusdem nominis, huius, vt opinor, Messalinæ frater, qui ob
opes & hortos egregios, quibus Agrippina inhiabat, accusa-
tus, vim vitæ suæ attulit. Sueton.in Nerone.

page.notes: The two coin legends are printed inside the medallion engravings; the right legend is partly cut off in the scan, so MESSALINA is doubtful. Plin. citation numeral read as II. No catchword visible.
